description: handleAuthRequest for '/v1/auth/discord/callback' at shell/index.ts:147-149 does NOT implement the callback flow specified in REQ-AUTH-002. The implementation returns a hardcoded 302 with Location header but: (1) does not receive or validate query params 'code' and 'state', (2) does not receive or validate the __Host-oauth_session cookie, (3) does not call consumeOAuthState for atomic state verification, (4) does not call exchangeDiscordCode or fetchDiscordUserId, (5) does not call saveDiscordLinkSession, (6) does not issue a __Host-link_session Set-Cookie header. The function always returns 302 regardless of input, making it incapable of returning 401 for any failure mode. This means PROP-AUTH-011 through PROP-AUTH-013 integration tests that claim to test 'via handleAuthRequest' for callback are not actually testing the callback flow — they test other endpoints or call lower-level functions directly.
